confidence_notes: I ran two web searches in total. The first returned the RBA AUD/USD rate of 0.6720 for 18 November 2026. That figure came from a search-result summary, not from opening the RBA page directly. The second search returned crowdsourced Lugano prices from MyLifeElsewhere: cappuccino about CHF 3.65-3.88, a pint of local beer about CHF 6.04-7.92 and a basic meal with a drink about CHF 25. These figures vary between pages and may be dated. The search did not return mid-range meal, cocktail or wine prices. I estimated those using typical Swiss ratios to beer and inexpensive-meal prices, so they are less certain. The CHF figures were converted at roughly 1.25 USD per CHF, and food and drink prices were nudged up for July lakefront tourist areas. All accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for peak summer and were not checked against live listings. Lugano has few hostels, so the hostel anchors are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Prices are based on Swiss national price levels and adjusted using comparable cities such as Lucerne, Locarno and Zurich. One crowdsourced source puts Lugano restaurant prices slightly below the Swiss average. Summer lake tourism raises July hotel rates.
